name: Catholic Charities, Inc. (Diocese of Wichita): veteran housing help (SSVF)
description: VA-funded Supportive Services for Veteran Families (SSVF, grant 14-KS-479): case management, help keeping a home, rapid rehousing and short-term financial help for low-income veteran households. Serves: Allen County, Bourbon County, Butler County, Chase County, Chautauqua County, Cherokee County, Coffey County, Cowley County, Crawford County, Elk County, Greenwood County, Harper County and 18 more.
next_step: Call SSVF intake with your county and housing situation: whether you are homeless now or at risk of losing housing, and who lives with you.
constraints: Serves only the areas listed; check that yours is included. Veteran-household, income and housing-status screening applies.
County and intake details come from VA’s FY26 SSVF provider intake list; confirm current service when calling.
